original.target_description: Jiang et al., Experiment 1, sports-shoe ad: Comparison of perceived comfort for circular versus angular logos.

n.quote: Undergraduates (N ¼ 109) were randomly assigned to one of three logo shape conditions: circular, angular, or no logo.
n.sample_role: Undergraduate participants in three-condition ANOVA; contrasts use pooled model error
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported in Experiment 1; denominator df 106 supports full sample.

replication.target_description: Motoki and Iseki (2022), replication of Jiang, Y., Gorn, G. J., Galli, M., & Chattopadhyay, A.: Comparison of perceived comfort for circular versus angular logos.

n.location: Methods, final sample; Results, Jiang et al. (2015), comfort
n.quote: Finally, the data of 823 participants (mean age = 40.77, SD of age = 10.48, 428 males, 391 females, 4 did not prefer to say) were analyzed.
n.sample_role: Participants in circular/angular comparison; subgroup n not explicitly printed; full study analyzed 823, pairwise F denominator df 550.
n.exclusions: 247 excluded after instructional manipulation and attention checks as reported; recruitment/exclusion arithmetic in source is inconsistent.

reported_success.quote: No studies involving visual factors, between-participant manipulation of senses, or interactions between factors could be replicated.

notes: Quotes normalize PDF/HTML line breaks. No statistics were converted. Original contrast uses pooled three-condition ANOVA error; 109 is model n, not a two-condition subtotal.
